results.headline: Aperam update on Q3 2026 market & financial t...

results.headline: September Update and Circular to Shareholders
results.key_quote: New Health grew revenue by approximately 50 per cent. in September and finished the month well ahead of the pace we reported two weeks ago.
results.summary: Medpal AI reported strong September 2026 results significantly exceeding recent internal expectations. New Health revenue surged 50% month-on-month to £2.7 million, with the month finishing well ahead of the pace reported just two weeks prior. The annualised revenue run rate reached over £38 million, up from £35 million reported on 21 September and £28 million in August. Recurring revenue (repeat orders and NHS prescriptions) exceeded £1 million, representing approximately one-third of total September revenue. The company has now served over 33,500 customers since July 2026. CEO Jason Drummond explicitly stated results were "well ahead of the pace" recently reported, indicating material outperformance against internal expectations.
metrics_ahead: New Health revenue growth of approximately 50% month-on-month
Annualised run rate of over £38 million, up from £35 million two weeks prior
